registry.name: Power Laws: Forecasting Energy Consumption
registry.licence: Public competition dataset, redistributed by reference only (not vendored)
registry.description: Metered building energy consumption for 267 anonymised sites at 5-30 min sampling, with per-site floor area, base temperature, weekly day-off calendar, nearest-station outdoor air temperature and a public-holiday calendar.

registry.name: Power Laws weather observations
registry.licence: Public competition dataset, redistributed by reference only
registry.description: Outdoor dry-bulb air temperature from weather stations near each site, with the station distance in km. Multiple stations per site.

registry.name: EcoTwin SAMPLE FIXTURE
registry.description: Deterministic synthetic stand-in used only when no real source file is present. Every value carries SAMPLE FIXTURE in provenance and the demo status bar switches to SAMPLE FIXTURE mode.

registry.name: EcoTwin gradient-boosted forecaster
registry.description: LightGBM regression on calendar, lag, rolling and weather features.

registry.name: EcoTwin residual anomaly engine
registry.description: Robust z-score of the forecast residual (actual - expected) against a rolling median/MAD baseline, with rule-based classification.

registry.name: pandapower load flow
registry.description: Balanced AC Newton-Raphson power flow over the EcoTwin LV model.

registry.name: BOPTEST building emulator
registry.description: Modelica building emulator driven over the BOPTEST REST API.

registry.name: EcoTwin RC thermal engine
registry.description: Lumped-parameter 2R2C zone thermal model with an explicit HVAC plant model (temperature-dependent COP). Used when a BOPTEST instance is not reachable. Reported as ECOTWIN_RC, never as BOPTEST.

registry.name: EcoTwin convex optimiser
registry.description: Convex program over comfort, peak, energy and control-movement terms.

registry.name: EcoTwin scenario engine
registry.description: Seeded, deterministic disturbance injection for what-if testing.

registry.name: EcoTwin precomputed demo cache
registry.description: Results computed ahead of time by the same code paths and replayed for hosted-demo latency. The originating engine is preserved in the record.

unit_hypothesis.statement: Value is energy in Wh consumed during the preceding 15-minute interval; load_kw = Value * 4 / 1000.
unit_hypothesis.validated_by: median power density inside 3.0-120.0 W/m2 using the published Surface
unit_hypothesis.consequence: All kW series are tagged DERIVED, never MEASURED.

building.selection_rule: 15-minute windows only; >= 40,000 samples; nearest weather station present; unit hypothesis plausible; site complete across the demo window; ranked on in-window diurnal swing, occupancy contrast and load factor.

demo_window.rule: longest window of 3..2 days keeping >= 6 sites at >= 98% joint load+weather completeness and >= 90 dense days of prior history and a contiguous 5-day dense feature lookback, maximising the summed daily load swing of the portfolio

transformer_sizing.rule: smallest IEC standard kVA >= P99 kW / pf * headroom
transformer_sizing.note: The dataset publishes no transformer nameplate data.

submetering.note: Only a whole-site meter exists. Feeder-level values in the network model are DERIVED by documented disaggregation, never presented as measured sub-meters.
